roleLabel: Warrior finisher — Execution axe that grows power from damage dealt and kill stacks
bestFor: Boards that can keep him casting Execution into real targets so permanent growth and Shields stack
strength: Execution scales the more it deals damage; Juggernaut turns that damage into lasting Shields
weakness: Slow without cast uptime; feels empty if he never connects or never gets kills on Momentous

howToPlay.early: He can front-mid if packs are melee. Buy Attack and enough survivability to finish the cast. Rush helps Iron.
howToPlay.mid: Iron = Rush team Attack/Defense for Warriors. Juggernaut = Shields from Execution damage. Momentous = kill → Mana + permanent Attack/Crit. Pick tribal Rush, self-Shield carry, or kill snowball.
howToPlay.late: Keep Execution firing every fight. Bloodshield/Aegis and Sundering help him live and crack tanks.
howToPlay.positioning: Front-mid on the pack he can actually hit. Execution is a swing, not a backline sniper spell.

abilityNotes.Execution: The cast is both the nuke and the growth engine. Missed targets mean missed permanent power — aim him at something he can finish damaging.

specNotes.The Iron: Warrior Rush tribal. Take with multiple Warriors triggering Rush.
specNotes.The Juggernaut: Selfish Shield carry from Execution damage — best solo Logan path.
specNotes.The Momentous: Kill snowball for Attack/Crit and Mana. Take when he can secure executes.

relicReasons.warriors-bloodshield-engine-4000: Shield loop pairs with Juggernaut’s lasting Shields.
relicReasons.warriors-bravery-banner-510: Warrior aggression banner for the finisher fantasy.

faq.question: Is Logan good in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Solid physical finisher when he casts into real fights. Weak if starved of targets or ranks. Buy him as mid-front damage, not a pure backline Mage.

faq.question: What class is Logan?
faq.answer: Warrior. Role focus: Execution axe with permanent growth from damage and kills.

faq.question: What relics work with Logan?
faq.answer: Warrior Sundering/Bloodshield/Bravery pieces and martial amplifiers.

faq.question: How do you play Logan?
faq.answer: Put him on contact, cast Execution often, and specialize toward Juggernaut Shields, Momentous kills, or Iron Rush tribal.

tips: If he never casts, buy tempo (AS/Mana/Rush) before more Attack.
Iron without other Warriors is usually worse than Juggernaut.
